assets.purpose: Predict and confirm contrasting opinions of the same food; unrecorded fictional practice dialogue.
assets.prompt: Photorealistic natural editorial photograph for an adult English coursebook. Landscape 3:2. Exactly two fictional adult friends, a Latina woman on the LEFT wearing a dark teal cotton blouse and a man on the RIGHT with short dark hair wearing a rust orange overshirt, at a small outdoor street-food counter in soft afternoon light. Both hold the SAME TYPE of small vegetarian bean burger in a bun with visible lettuce and red pepper relish. Left woman has just taken a bite, looks warmly delighted, a pleased smile, looking at her friend; right man has taken a bite, looks mildly unconvinced with a natural slight grimace and raised eyebrow, not distressed, not exaggerated, looking at his burger. A single small shared tray of golden fries is clearly visible on the counter between them. Exact pedagogical point: two people can have DIFFERENT opinions of the SAME food. The picture invites a prediction, printed dialogue supplies their actual opinions. Friendly everyday comic contrast without humiliation. Show faces, both burgers and fries large and clear, natural anatomy, believable hands, lived-in food stall environmental background intact. Waist-up medium shot. Rich realistic colors, sober photographic quality. No text, no labels, no brands, no watermarks, no extra foreground people, no fake transparent backdrop.
